game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before goblin raiders act.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before goblin raiders act. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the shield value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the royal vault using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the royal vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 18.
